calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_year, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) nd, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ns, sum(net_amount) net, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) nl
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, s.store_id<900 AS is_store, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date bd, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) nb FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT return_date bd, s.store_id, sum(refund_net) rn FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=x.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=x.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1,2),
c AS (SELECT bd, store_id, nb, coalesce(rn,0) rn FROM l LEFT JOIN r USING (bd, store_id))
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
 round(sum(c.nb-c.rn),2) mine, round((SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales q WHERE q.business_date=d.calendar_date AND q.store_id<900),2) rpt,
 count(DISTINCT c.store_id) ns
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN c ON c.bd=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_weeks AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
    (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
  FROM dim_store st
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_period = 1) d
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl AS (
  SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty
  JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
  WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)
),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, count(DISTINCT n.store_id) stores
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year, ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),2) AS lfl_growth_pct, ty.stores, ly.stores, (SELECT count(*) FROM lfl) sw
FROM sales ty, sales ly WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
